top_rigor_problems: F5-P (23): a juxtaposition ties the Brussels martyrs to married priests, though they died for the evangelical teaching. This is the only BLOCK.

Small unverified flourishes and overreach: 'the father led' the morning blessing (21), 'kept the altar and the font' (22), 'no woman's own writing survives' (10), 'none of that was done in hiding' beside the Wartburg (14).
Retrieval gaps rather than errors: truly-god-and-truly-man is used but not cited (1, 4), and the surviving Wittenberg houses are missed for physical evidence (22).
top_access_problems: Engine-cut orphans where a sentence was removed: 'Not one or the other. Both...' (1), 'That confession is what we have' (3), 'That condition... is where the judgment begins' (28), and a duplicated creed splice (4).
Build/system vocabulary reaching the participant: 'vendored', 'mark the record by its id, and the system places...' (10), 'No force in the evidence' (22).
Several answers run 330-370 words, with boilerplate repeated across answers ('We did not invent it and we did not discover it freshly ourselves', 'Those reports exist. We do not hold them.').
world_summary.cost_note: Costs are low and flat at about $0.025-0.034 per answer after caching; #1 ($0.146) is an uncached outlier. Most longer than their value: 10 (~170 extra words), 11 (~170), 13 (~120), 9, 18 and 17 (~100-110 each), 3 (~90). Trimming repeated boilerplate and restated conclusions would cut output tokens by about 20-25% with no loss.
world_summary.go_live_view: Close to fit. Rigor is strong: 27 of 28 answers are SOUND or ACCEPTABLE, the voice keeps to its records, handles false premises well (torture, catacombs), and is unusually honest about the visitation and household-reception gaps. The single blocking error is one misleading juxtaposition in F5-P. What holds it back is craft. Four answers show removed-sentence orphans and two leak build vocabulary, both of which a participant would notice. The single most valuable fix is at the engine: when a sentence is cut, also remove or rewrite any following sentence that points back to it ('Both', 'That confession', 'That condition'), and filter system terms ('vendored', 'record by its id', 'force'). Then fix F5-P and ship.
